name: North Korea
overview: Scripture reveals that facing formidable enemies, like the nations surrounding Israel, often brings fear and doubt, as seen when the spies in Numbers expressed their inability to overcome stronger peoples. Yet God commands His people not to fear overwhelming forces, for He is with them and empowers victory, reminding us that opposition serves His sovereign purposes, including the hardening of hearts to fulfill His judgment as in Joshua. The Psalms warn that earthly rulers who unite against the Lord and His Anointed stand opposed to divine authority and righteousness. Therefore, believers confronted with hostile powers, such as those represented by North Korea, are called to trust in God's presence and justice rather than in human strength or fearful counsel.
